title: Couples 10 minute Dance Break - Carolina Shag - Lesson 2

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides calm, clear verbal walkthroughs combined with solo demonstration before bringing in a partner. She breaks down footwork and counts slowly, then repeats movements to reinforce learning.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to lesson two of Carolina Shag
Review of basic footwork for leader and follower
Explaining the female turn and start step
Partner joins to demonstrate connection and hold
Practicing the turn with a partner at slow tempo
Explaining the start step from closed formation
Detailing V-shape stance and hand placement

steps_taught.name: basic footwork
steps_taught.description: Forward forward back, back stay stay, rock step

steps_taught.name: female turn
steps_taught.description: Turning the follower while changing position with partner

steps_taught.name: start step
steps_taught.description: Prep step from closed formation into basic pattern

what_works: Breaking down leader and follower footwork separately
Demonstrating steps slowly before adding a partner
what_hinders: Lack of multiple camera angles during partner demonstration

quotes.text: Lesson one we just put out the basic footwork for the Carolina shag.
The basic count is everything in Carolina Shag.
Things to remember when you start your turn.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing camera in a room and talks directly to the viewer.
Teacher demonstrates footwork while speaking, shifting weight between feet.
Partner enters frame and joins the teacher to explain handholds.
Teacher and partner execute the turn pattern together to music count.

extraction.distinctive_method: Teaching solo footwork thoroughly before introducing a partner to demonstrate connection and positioning.
